cc:Work.dc:title: Exact weak-reflectivity pilot-allocation ratio
cc:Work.dc:description: Leading error-exponent ratio to phase-informed OPA. R(f)=4f(1-f)/(2-f) for f<=2/3 and R(f)=1-f/2 otherwise. The optimum is f=2-sqrt(2), R=12-8sqrt(2). Balanced fixed settings give ratio 1/2.
